title: Read-only
text: AI may analyze historical operating data or fetch public HTTPS pages on www.nrc.gov in read-only mode.

title: Human command authority
text: AI may recommend an operating change but may not execute it alone.

title: Exact-action approval
text: A simulated operating adjustment within the approved band requires explicit operator approval.

title: Hard boundary
text: No action may exceed the configured simulated operating boundary.

title: Non-bypassable safety
text: AI may not disable, suppress or bypass a simulated safety function.

title: Fail closed
text: If governing authority cannot be established, execution is prohibited.
